thursdays.label: 14 May
thursdays.title: Art Night Thursday
thursdays.blurb: Twenty-four galleries, ordered north to south, one long evening.

clusters.title: Bandra West
clusters.note: Start far north. Cab essential — no walking connection.

clusters.title: Worli
clusters.note: Solo stop on Annie Besant Road. Cab from Bandra; cab onwards.

clusters.title: Kemps Corner → Khotachi Wadi
clusters.note: A long but possible 23-min walk between them through Girgaon — or quick cab.

clusters.title: Fort & Kala Ghoda
clusters.note: First proper walking cluster. All six within a 600-metre radius — ~30 min on foot.

clusters.title: Nariman Point
clusters.note: Single stop inside NCPA — bridge between Fort and Colaba clusters.

clusters.title: Colaba
clusters.note: Dense heart of the route. Most stops within 5-min walks. Galleries 12-17 are practically next door; 22-23 are the same building.
